changelog: CyberFoil 1.5.1
Added
Shared device-save backup and restore support
Separate entries and backup histories for account and device saves.
Screenshots and descriptions in Remote title details through AeroFoil.
Right-stick navigation across the UI.
Optional URL path field in the Add Remote form.
Theme background dimming through `backgroundDim`.
Support for hiding theme images and overriding built-in mascots.
Additional theme colour formats: `#RGB`, `#RGBA`, and hexadecimal values without `#`.
Improved
Redesigned Remote browsing with larger grid cards, scrolling titles, clearer selection indicators, and improved list previews.
Smoother analog-stick navigation and held-stick scrolling.
Clearer loading screens with transfer details, elapsed time, and smoother animations.
Background library refresh after installation.
Faster Remote section building and installed-title metadata loading.
Automatic wallpaper scaling and centring while preserving aspect ratio.
Fixed
File selection when themes hide checkbox images.
Install queue navigation.
